principle: Use actual connected components and unchanged final dimensions. Repeated matching-type pieces use one representative with honest quantity/variation wording.
recipe_syntax: All IDs in recipe strings are unquoted for machine parsing; wrap each ID in backticks in manuscript. Existing @ fixed-receiver style may be used consistently.

item_changes.name: Shaped table rails
item_changes.description: Prepared retaining rails, a launch-lane divider and inward return lips, each with integral push-fit feet. Their different curves guide the marble; the icon shows one representative rail.

new_items.name: Catch apron and cup
new_items.description: One connected front apron with its side rims, storage cup and locating bridges. It catches the marble at the player’s end.

new_items.name: Tray with guiding rails
new_items.description: The side rails, curved return lips and launch divider are fitted. The connected catch apron still belongs at the front.

item_changes.name: Three target arches
item_changes.description: Three matching clip-in arches with different shot markings. The icon shows one arch. A marble can roll through each without leaving the table.

new_items.name: Manual score wheel
new_items.description: A numbered wheel already retained on its bearing and edge rail. The rail clips to the table; turn the wheel by hand after a successful shot.

new_items.name: Table with three target arches
new_items.description: The three arches are in place. The manual score wheel clips onto the left edge.

item_changes.name: Dragon body
item_changes.description: One stiff card body with lightweight back scales, folded base tabs and drawn spectacles. Its wing and tail attachment holes are prepared.

item_changes.name: Wing hinge fittings
item_changes.description: Two broad-headed wing pins with spacing collars and smooth retaining washers. One complete fitting represents the pair; the tail arrives with its own captive pin.

new_items.name: Two card wings
new_items.description: A mirrored pair of light wings, each with a prepared hinge hole and its integral drive tab. One wing represents the pair.

new_items.name: Pinned dragon tail
new_items.description: One decorative card tail with its captive pin, washer and broad retainer. Its hole matches the prepared body hole.

new_items.name: Wings with hinge fittings
new_items.description: The pins and spacing collars are fitted to the wings. Release and reseat their retainers when fitting the pair through the body’s shoulder holes.

new_items.name: Dragon with hinged wings
new_items.description: Both wings pivot clear of the body. Fit the tail through its prepared hole before mounting the dragon.

item_changes.name: Paired barrel cups
item_changes.description: Two barrel cups with captive mounting fasteners. The rear cup has a soft retaining strap factory-bonded into it; the front cup supports the nozzle end. The icon shows the strapped rear cup.

item_changes.name: Syringe in barrel cups
item_changes.description: The cups cradle the barrel, and the rear strap retains it. The plunger is still free until its thumb pad meets the separate capture clip.

new_items.name: Plunger capture clip
new_items.description: One connected pair of C-shaped jaws on a bridge and central support. It fits the sliding crosshead and captures the output syringe’s thumb pad.

new_items.name: Grabber ready for its syringe
new_items.description: The capture clip is on the crosshead. Seat the syringe cups on the beam with its nozzle toward the handle, and snap its thumb pad into the clip.

item_changes.name: Tube routing clips
item_changes.description: Two gentle C-clips on prepared peel-and-stick feet. One clip represents the pair. They hold the tube without flattening it, leaving a loose loop for handling.

item_changes.name: Sponge pear
item_changes.description: One light sponge pear for the grabber to carry. Jo puts a collecting cup on the garden table; the cup is part of the game setting.

new_items.name: Hand-syringe holders
new_items.description: Two strapped cups on prepared peel-and-stick feet, one shaped for the handgrip and the other for the beam. One complete holder represents the pair.

new_items.name: Grabber with its hand syringe held
new_items.description: The strapped holders support the hand syringe beside the grip. Route the tube into its two gentle clips, keeping a free handling loop.

notes: Keep the existing fruit-game recipe. Revise reward prose to use the same sponge pear and Jo’s setting cup; no inventory cup disappears.

item_changes.name: Prepared rover deck
item_changes.description: Keep the existing deck/jig/mount-hole description, and add: the fixed pen guide rods, removable captive top caps, return spring, hand-operated lift cam and lever stops are already mounted on the deck. The sliding pen carriage will be fitted later.

notes: This is a real ownership change: the stationary pen mechanism becomes supplied deck hardware and must appear from the first rover-deck view. The moving carriage and pen remain absent until their authored fitting.

item_changes.name: Sliding pen carriage
item_changes.description: One connected carriage bridge with its spring C-clip, follower shoe and joining web. It slides on the prepared guide rods; the deck’s hand lever raises the follower.

item_changes.name: Pen in its sliding carriage
item_changes.description: The pen is gripped in the connected carriage. With the rover stopped, release the captive guide caps, slide the carriage onto the rods, seat the return spring, and replace the caps.

notes: Retain both existing pen preparation/installation recipes. Describe releasing/reseating the actual captive guide caps to establish assembly access; never say the loose carriage contains the hand lever.

item_changes.name: Lift support extensions
item_changes.description: Four measured extension struts with their locked sleeves and transverse pins. One complete extension represents the set. Work with the lift module supported and disconnected: fit them between its original short supports and lower frame, and move the same counterweight to the marked rear tray slot.

item_changes.name: Whale with fork saddles
item_changes.description: The two compression forks rest against the upper spar. Jo supports them while the prepared lift module is seated beneath them.

item_changes.name: Hinged service hatch
item_changes.description: One connected light surround with its hinged paper flap, rib brackets and latch. It opens over the controller and counterweight; the outside stop guide is a separate fitting.

item_changes.name: Stop button and pushrod
item_changes.description: One connected red push button and matching pushrod. Slide the rod through the fitted guide to meet the module’s stop switch.

new_items.name: Lift harness extension
new_items.description: One measured insulated lead with its two inline connectors. It bridges the extended gap between the original controller lead and tile lead without stretching either.

new_items.name: Compression forks
new_items.description: Two rigid U-shaped fork saddles. Each has two legs and one crosshead. Their crossheads bear against the whale’s upper spar while their feet receive the lift cradle.

new_items.name: Upper retaining straps
new_items.description: Two prepared straps, each one continuous piece. They retain the original upper cradle against the fork saddles after the module is seated.

new_items.name: Outside stop guide
new_items.description: One pushrod guide with its support flange and real rib bracket. It mounts beside the hatch, ready to receive the connected red button and pushrod.

new_items.name: Extended lift module
new_items.description: The original supports retain their lengths; the four extra struts bridge the gap to the lower frame. The original short electrical leads need the measured extension before the module can run.

new_items.name: Extended module with its harness
new_items.description: The added lead joins both original connectors. The complete module is still supported and disconnected while Jo helps seat it beneath the fork saddles.

new_items.name: Lift module seated in the whale
new_items.description: The tile cradle meets the forks beneath the upper spar; the battery and counterweight hang low. Jo keeps the assembly supported while you fit the retaining straps.

new_items.name: Whale with an outside stop guide
new_items.description: The guide is mounted beside the hatch. Its open bore lines up the pushrod with the module’s stop switch.

notes: Retain skin/hatch recipes after whale-lift-inside. Module extension/harness work is on the portable supported module before insertion; fork saddles go on the fixed whale frame.

item_changes.name: Four guide posts
item_changes.description: Four smooth guide posts. Fit them into the test base; the cradle’s guide rings slide over their bare tops. The separate nuts retain the rings after fitting.

item_changes.name: Stand with bare guide posts
item_changes.description: The four posts are fitted to the tethered base. Their tops remain open for the cradle’s sliding guide rings.

item_changes.name: Tile in its guided cradle
item_changes.description: The tile sits in its padded cradle, with both crossbars clamped to the lower frame and their guide rings ready for the stand’s posts.

new_items.name: Sliding guide crossbars
new_items.description: Two connected crossbars, each with its guide rings and removable cradle-frame clamps. Fit them to the lower cradle before sliding their rings over the four posts.

new_items.name: Four guide-post nuts
new_items.description: Four broad retaining nuts. Fit them after the cradle is on the posts; the guide rings can travel below them without lifting off.

new_items.name: Cradle with sliding guide bars
new_items.description: The two crossbars clamp to the lower cradle. Their open rings will slide over the stand’s bare posts.

new_items.name: Tile cradle seated on guide posts
new_items.description: The guide rings have slid over the four posts. Add the four retaining nuts before the first powered test.

notes: Retain posts+tethered-base -> lift-guided-base, but its artwork omits the not-yet-fitted bars and nuts. This correction adds2 operations; combined split plan adds12, for193 total. All fitted source dimensions and final geometry remain unchanged.

item_changes.name: Dragon mounting sections
item_changes.description: Four mounting sections in two matching long/short pairs, with four captive pins. One actual long section represents the supply.

item_changes.name: Fused power divider
item_changes.description: The battery and fused divider with their connected motor and lamp leads. The switch parking dock is a separate fitting.

new_items.name: Switch parking dock
new_items.description: A small teal parking plate on a short support arm. It mounts under the deck to hold the wired accessory switch.

new_items.name: Whale with switch dock
new_items.description: The switch parking dock is fixed beneath the deck; the battery and fused power divider are not yet fitted.

notes: The canonical power-divider group includes a dock and support arm attached to the deck rather than the battery assembly. Supply those actual components in their own operation; final fitted geometry and dimensions remain unchanged.
